design_principle: Split by SOURCE FAMILY and by CHRONOLOGICAL PERIOD. Development material is older and mentorship/journal-2025 based; evaluation material is a chronological holdout (2026) from different authors. No lesson, trade, or decision cycle contributes records to both partitions.

DEV.purpose: Learning / development: rich contextual-selection material with explicit alternatives and decision-time availability.
sources: ICT official 2022 mentorship (Ep.3, Ep.12) via youtube + notes layer
ICT 2024 live lesson via community notes

EVAL.purpose: Evaluation / chronological holdout: distinct authors, 2026 period, post-dates every DEV record. Includes both positive selection acts and documented management/selection deviations.

rules: All five Ep.3-derived records share one lesson/chart-day and stay together in DEV (they encode different element types / alternatives of the same selection event — they are facets, not duplicates).
SXM-2025-09-25 posts -007 and -008 are one decision cycle (analysis + trade log) and stay together in DEV.
Marcus 2026-04-13 / 2026-04-14 are consecutive-day same-template logs and stay together in EVAL.

No record appears in both partitions; no source author spans both partitions except SXM, and SXM's records are split by period (2025 in DEV, 2026 notes in EVAL) — the 2026 notes are a different content type (principles, not trades), so they are not near-duplicates of the 2025 trade records.
near_duplicate_policy.verification: Record-level dedupe check performed at dataset assembly: 11 unique record_ids; no price-coordinate pair repeated across partitions for the same trade.

usage_rules: DEV may be used to fit/choose selection logic; EVAL must not be used to tune anything in this V1 (it is the honest default test set once a selection model exists).
Both partitions carry the same label contract: the human-selected candidate is the SOURCE'S task-correct answer for its stated act — never 'the true/best element'.
Outcome fields (Win/BEP/Profit) are context only and must never be used as labels.
Extraction-coverage denominators count only coordinate-bearing records (all except RCA-2026-JUN30-SXM-011).
